abstract: Install and run F5-TTS, the flow-matching zero-shot voice-cloning text-to-speech model. References cover PyTorch per device, the infer CLI and Python API with verified defaults, the Gradio app and socket server, checkpoints and the CC-BY-NC licence, community language models, fine-tuning entry points, updating and troubleshooting, with a TOML template and a guard-railed wrapper script.
